verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents a Cmd+K command palette (Superhuman Command) where you can 'instantly do any action' and learn its shortcut, plus 'blazingly fast shortcuts' and keyboard-triggered Snippets. One user calls search and UI transitions 'blazing fast', but another ex-user reports searches regularly taking ten seconds, and users describe mobile apps as slow and RAM-heavy. Missing for 10: a documented, comprehensive shortcut reference; consistent independent corroboration of 'never wait' speed (contradicted for search and mobile); evidence that every action is keyboard-reachable beyond the palette claim.
